title: Data Fundamentals and Preparation
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Data Fundamentals and Preparation and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

notes: All 7 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. Data quality and governance shape downstream outcomes. Record where data came from, what it means, and how it was transformed before training. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
